title: emss 0.1.0
text: First release. emss implements Embedded Standard Setting (ESS): estimates cut scores panelists’ item–level alignments item locations. Cut scores can estimated either criterion: ESS-Count (number inconsistent items) ESS-Weight (summed distance inconsistent items). Results given panelist aggregated across panelists (modal, median mean), grade, round , optionally, domain. Diagnostics include panelist agreement, item review (consistent, essentially consistent inconsistent items) impact data examinee scores. update() evaluates manually set cut scores, bootstrapping() gives standard errors estimated cuts. Input can come Excel workbook data frames CSV files via ess_data(). report() plot() produce tables figures results.
